title: Lead classification (AI output)
description: Strict JSON returned by the AI step for one normalized message.

category.description: hot_lead: clear need plus budget, timeline or buying intent. cold_lead: vague or early research. support: existing customer needs help. spam: unsolicited, irrelevant or malicious.

name.description: Sender name as stated in the message or headers, else null.

company.description: Company the sender represents, else null.

budget.description: Budget exactly as stated, for example "$5,000". Null if not stated. Never invented.

need.description: One-sentence summary of what the sender wants.

reply_draft.description: Short polite reply signed "The Demo Team". Null for spam.
